texts.li: Since the truth about {A_nameDef} came out ({SECRET}), the dining room goes quiet whenever {A_nameDef} sits down, and a few people have started bolting their doors at night.\n\nNo one has done anything yet, but people keep coming to the council one at a time, in low voices, to ask what it means to do about {A_nameDef}. Some want {A_objective} watched. Some want the matter forgotten. One or two would like {A_objective} gone, and won't quite say so.

The whole colony has heard by now ({SECRET}). {A_nameDef} hasn't denied any of it and hasn't explained any of it, and the silence is doing more harm than the truth did.\n\nOpinion is split. Some say people can change, and that {A_nameDef} has never given anyone here a reason to doubt it. Others say a dangerous person would be careful not to.

li.label: Keep {A_nameDef} under watch for a season
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is never alone now. Someone always works the next field, sits at the next table and sleeps in the next room. People are calmer for it, and {A_nameDef} has stopped talking to almost anyone.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} is watched day and night now, and it has only made {A_objective} angrier. The people doing the watching are sick of it too.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} work off the past
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} has taken the worst jobs in the colony for a while: hauling corpses, cleaning up after the butchering, the night shifts no one wants. {A_nameDef} hasn't apologized and no one has asked {A_objective} to, but some of the looks have softened.

li.label: What's past is past
li.outcome: The council ruled that whatever {A_nameDef} did before arriving belongs to another life. Some agreed. Others have started counting the kitchen knives at night.

li.label: Have {A_nameDef} tell the whole story
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} told it all that night, the worst parts too, and never asked to be forgiven. People stayed to the end, and afterward a few of them sat with {A_objective} until the fire was out.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} told it all and held nothing back. Some of the details were worse than anyone had imagined, and people started getting up and leaving long before the end.

texts.li: A message came over the comms this morning, polite and very well informed. Somebody out there has heard what everyone here now knows ({SECRET}), and a band of bounty hunters would like to collect {A_nameDef}.\n\nThey aren't asking the colony to fight anyone. They want to know when {A_nameDef} will next be out alone, and for everyone else to stay indoors when they come. For that they will pay 300 silver today, up front.

Word of {A_nameDef}'s past has reached the trade roads. A bounty hunter came to the gate this morning asking for {A_nameDef} by name, and offered the colony 300 silver for the hour {A_nameDef} next goes out alone, and a promise that no one will interfere.\n\n{A_nameDef} heard about the offer within the hour, has stopped going out alone, and watches the council's faces closely.

li.label: Take the silver and tell them
li.outcome: The council took the hunters' silver and told them what they wanted to know. The hunters haven't come yet, and there's no telling when they will. {A_nameDef} sleeps with a knife under the pillow now, and no longer trusts anyone on the council.

li.label: Sell them a false trail
li.outcome: The council sold the hunters a story about {A_nameDef} heading north with a caravan, and took 150 silver for the trouble. The hunters thanked the council politely and set off north.
li.riskOutcome: The council sold the hunters a story about {A_nameDef} heading north, and took their silver for it. A week later word came back that the hunters had found the north empty, and were on their way back. The colony has been watching the tree line since.

li.label: Refuse, and tell them the gate stays shut
li.outcome: The council told the hunters that {A_nameDef} belongs to this colony and that the gate stays shut. Their reply was short and polite, and it has left people uneasy.

texts.li: No one has said a word against {A_nameDef}'s doctoring since the secret came out ({SECRET}). They haven't needed to. The last two patients asked for someone else, and the one before that wanted to know exactly what was in the medicine.\n\nThe council has to decide whether {A_nameDef} still treats the sick here, and it had better decide before the next raid.

Someone has a gash on the arm that needs stitching. {A_nameDef} is standing at the medicine shelf, and the patient is looking at the door. They all know now ({SECRET}).\n\n{A_nameDef} has said nothing in {A_possessive} own defense. The council has been asked, by the patient most of all, who holds the needle from now on.

li.label: {A_nameDef} keeps doctoring, as before
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} went back to the medicine shelf with the council's blessing. Some patients still flinch at the needle, though fewer each week.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} went back to the medicine shelf with the council's blessing. The first patient flinched so hard at the needle that {A_nameDef}'s hands have been unsteady ever since.

li.label: Only with someone else watching
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} still treats the sick, with someone watching every stitch. The work is slower and {A_nameDef} hates it, but {A_possessive} hands are getting surer.

li.label: Take {A_possessive} instruments away
li.outcome: {A_nameDef}'s instruments have gone to someone else. Some people are relieved. Others wonder who will set their bones now. {A_nameDef} has barely spoken since.

texts.li: {B_nameDef} hasn't stopped talking about {A_nameDef}'s secret ({SECRET}) since it came out. {B_nameDef} brings it up at meals and on shift, with a new detail every time.\n\n{A_nameDef} has asked the council to make it stop. {B_nameDef} says this is a free colony and the truth is the truth.

{B_nameDef} has turned {A_nameDef}'s secret into the colony's favorite story. They've all heard it by now ({SECRET}), and the version going around has grown some parts {A_nameDef} swears never happened.\n\n{A_nameDef} came to the council red-faced and asked for it to end. {B_nameDef} came too, to argue that the story is mostly true.

li.label: Order {B_nameDef} to drop the subject
li.outcome: The council told {B_nameDef} to drop it, and {B_nameDef} has, at least out loud. The looks across the dinner table haven't stopped.
li.riskOutcome: The council told {B_nameDef} to drop it. {B_nameDef} did, and has been telling people since that the council is protecting {A_nameDef} for reasons of its own.

li.label: Make {B_nameDef} apologize at supper
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} apologized to {A_nameDef} at supper, in a voice that could have frozen soup. The story hasn't been repeated since, at least not where {A_nameDef} can hear.
li.riskOutcome: The apology began well enough, then turned into {B_nameDef} explaining to the whole table why {A_nameDef} deserved every word of the gossip. {A_nameDef} threw the first punch.

li.label: Sit them down until they sort it out
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} were shut in the council room with a pot of tea and told not to come out until it was settled. It took most of a day. They came out talking.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} were shut in the council room together to sort it out. Within the hour they were fighting, and the teapot was in pieces on the floor.

li.label: It's out. People will talk
li.outcome: The council decided there was nothing to be done about talk. {B_nameDef} has carried on telling the story, and {A_nameDef} has stopped bringing problems to the council.

texts.li: A message came over the comms this morning for {A_nameDef}, and whoever picked it up read it aloud before thinking better of it. The pirates {A_nameDef} owes want the old debt paid with interest, 400 silver, or they will come and collect it some other way.\n\n{A_nameDef} has asked the council for help, without quite looking anyone in the eye.

Word of {A_nameDef}'s debt has spread, and it has reached the people {A_nameDef} owes. They want 400 silver sent with the next caravan, and say they will then consider the matter closed.\n\nIt's a lot of silver. It's also a large band of pirates, and they know where the colony is. {A_nameDef} hasn't slept properly since the demand came, and has asked the council what it means to do.

li.label: Pay it, all of it
li.outcome: The 400 silver went out with the next caravan, and word came back that the matter is closed. {A_nameDef} has been working like two people ever since, trying to pay the colony back.

li.label: Pay it, and {A_nameDef} works it off
li.outcome: The colony paid the pirates, and {A_nameDef} is paying the colony back with every dirty job and long shift going, until the council says the debt is square. That will take a while.

li.label: Send half, and haggle
li.outcome: The pirates took 200 silver and a long, flattering letter. Their reply was rude, but they called the debt settled, and {A_nameDef} is glad to take that.
li.riskOutcome: The pirates took the 200 silver and sent back word that they still expect the other half. {A_nameDef} has taken to watching the horizon, and so have the others.

li.label: Not one coin
li.outcome: The council sent the pirates nothing and told {A_nameDef} the debt is {A_possessive} own problem. {A_nameDef} took it badly, and has been jumping at every sound since.
li.riskOutcome: The council sent the pirates nothing. Two days later their answer came back, saying only that they were disappointed. The colony has been sleeping badly since.

texts.li: Since the secret came out ({SECRET}), {A_nameDef} has been trying to stay out of sight, and failing, because people keep finding {A_objective} to say thank you.\n\nSome want the council to mark it properly, with a cup raised at supper. Others think {A_nameDef} would hate that more than anything.

It's out ({SECRET}), and the colony doesn't quite know what to do with it. People have been leaving small things at {A_nameDef}'s door: a carved spoon, a good apple, a note that just says "we know."\n\nThe council has been asked to do something proper about it. {A_nameDef} has asked the council, very firmly, to do nothing at all.

li.label: Raise a cup to {A_objective} at supper
li.outcome: The council put on a proper supper and the colony raised a cup to {A_nameDef}, who went the color of a beet and said nothing at all. People talked about the evening for days.
li.riskOutcome: The colony raised a cup to {A_nameDef} at supper. {A_nameDef} mumbled something into {A_possessive} cup, left before the food was served, and spent the evening in the storeroom with the door shut.

li.label: Thank {A_objective} in private
li.outcome: A few plain words of thanks, in private, and the council left it there. {A_nameDef} seemed relieved, though a few people wanted to do more.

li.label: Make it everyone's job from now on
li.outcome: The council put {A_nameDef} in charge of a roster for mending, blankets, birthdays and the rest, with everyone taking turns. Some of the others had no idea how much darning it involved.

texts.li: People have started holding their breath when {A_nameDef} walks past. They know now ({SECRET}), and no one is sure whether there's anything to catch.\n\n{B_nameDef}, who knows more medicine than most here, has offered to examine everyone. Others want {A_nameDef} moved to a room apart until they're sure. {A_nameDef} points out that {A_pronoun} has slept a wall away from them for months, and in all that time not one of them has fallen ill.

Some of the colonists have started eating at the far end of the table from {A_nameDef}, and the rest are embarrassed about it. They've all heard by now ({SECRET}), and no one knows what it means for them.\n\n{B_nameDef} wants to examine everyone properly before anyone panics. Some of the others would rather keep {A_nameDef} apart first and examine afterward.

li.label: A room apart, until it's certain
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} has a room apart now, with meals left at the door and visitors talking through it. So far no one else has fallen ill, but the door stays shut.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} lasted two days alone in that room, then walked out without a word, past the others and on toward the fields.

li.label: {B_nameDef} examines everyone
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} spent two days poking, prodding and listening to chests, and announced that the colony is as healthy as it ever was. People complain about {B_possessive} cold hands now instead of about {A_nameDef}.
li.riskOutcome: {B_nameDef} examined everyone, found nothing and said so. Not everyone believes it, and some people have started scrubbing their hands raw after every meal.

li.label: No quarantine, no fuss
li.outcome: The council said there was nothing to fear, and asked everyone to behave as if they believed it. Most do. {A_nameDef} has noticed the ones who don't.

texts.li: {B_nameDef} has wanted a demonstration ever since the colony learned about {A_nameDef}'s years in the death pits: one friendly bout in the yard, for anyone who cares to watch.\n\n{A_nameDef} has said no twice. {B_nameDef} has started telling people that {A_nameDef} is afraid, and the council has been asked to settle it.

Now that the colony knows about {A_nameDef}'s past in the pits, there's a betting pool. {B_nameDef} has put up a challenge, and plenty of people have put up silver on how long {B_pronoun} will last.\n\n{A_nameDef} wants nothing to do with it. Most of the bettors want the council to let the fight go ahead.

li.label: One bout, by the rules
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} had their bout in the yard, and the colony got its show. When it was over, {A_nameDef} walked off without looking at anyone and didn't come to supper.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} teach fighting instead
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} turned the challenge into a class. {B_nameDef} got forty rounds of footwork drills instead of a fight, and came away bruised and a good deal better at it. Several others have asked to join the next class.

li.label: No fighting. The pits are behind {A_objective}
li.outcome: The council forbade the bout. {A_nameDef} was plainly relieved. {B_nameDef} grumbled about it for days, along with everyone who had silver on the fight.
li.riskOutcome: The council forbade the bout. {B_nameDef} tried one more taunt anyway, in the dining room, and {A_nameDef} put {B_objective} on the floor before anyone could step in.

texts.li: Since the truth came out ({SECRET}), {A_nameDef} has stopped hiding it. {A_nameDef}'s hands shake openly in the mornings, and the old hiding place behind the storeroom sits empty, since everyone knows about it now.\n\n{B_nameDef} has offered to stay with {A_nameDef} through the worst of getting clean, if the council will spare them both from work for a week. Others want {A_nameDef}'s room searched and whatever is found burned.

Now that it's out, {A_nameDef} has admitted all of it: the using, the hiding, how long it's been going on. Asked what {A_pronoun} needs, {A_nameDef} said a week. Asked what the colony needs, a few people said a lock on the medicine shelf.\n\n{B_nameDef} has said {B_pronoun} will see {A_nameDef} through it, if the council allows. Not everyone thinks the council should be in the business of second chances.

li.label: A week off, with {B_nameDef} beside {A_objective}
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} have been excused from work for a week. It was a hard week, full of shakes and sweats and bargaining, and {A_nameDef} is still clean at the end of it.
li.riskOutcome: The week was harder than either of them expected. {B_nameDef} has barely slept, sitting up through the shakes and the bargaining. {A_nameDef} is clean this morning. {B_nameDef} is asleep on the floor beside the bed.

li.label: Search {A_possessive} room and burn what's found
li.outcome: {A_nameDef}'s room was turned out and everything found in it burned in the yard. Most people feel safer for it. {A_nameDef} hasn't said a word to anyone since.
li.riskOutcome: The search turned up a second stash no one had known about. When it went on the fire, {A_nameDef} lost {A_possessive} temper and started smashing furniture.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} handle it alone
li.outcome: The council decided this was {A_nameDef}'s fight. {A_nameDef} has been fighting it alone and, so far, just about winning.
li.riskOutcome: Left to handle it alone, {A_nameDef} lasted three days. Today is a bad one.

texts.li: For days the colony has talked about little except {A_nameDef}'s secret ({SECRET}). Conversations stop when {A_nameDef} walks in and start up again, in lower voices, when {A_nameDef} leaves.\n\nSome want to talk it through properly, once, and be done with it. {A_nameDef} isn't sure that would help anyone but the people who want to hear it.

The colony can't let it go. They all know now ({SECRET}), they all have opinions, and most of those opinions have been shared with {A_nameDef} whether {A_pronoun} wanted them or not.\n\nThe council has been asked to settle how the colony deals with it. {A_nameDef} would like a say in that too.

li.label: Talk it through one evening
li.outcome: The colony gathered one evening and {A_nameDef} answered every question, the kind ones and the unkind ones. By the end the questions had run out, and people were just talking.
li.riskOutcome: The evening went well until somebody asked the wrong question and somebody else laughed. {A_nameDef} answered everything after that in single words, and left early.

li.label: The subject is closed
li.outcome: The matter is closed, by order of the council. People still talk when {A_nameDef} isn't in the room, but {A_nameDef} can eat dinner in peace.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} decide
li.outcome: The council left it to {A_nameDef}, who thought about it for a day and decided to carry on as before. Bit by bit, the others are doing the same.
li.riskOutcome: The council left it to {A_nameDef}, who decided to say nothing at all. The colony has filled the silence with its own versions, and some of them are worse than the truth.
